prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1172; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in the claim file. Our client was hurt in the incident and is seeking compensation for medical care, lost income, and the pain and disruption that followed. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you, your staff, or any adjuster or representative acting on your behalf.

We ask that you provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits for every policy that may apply to the at-fault driver, together with the declarations pages and any excess or umbrella coverage that may exist. Please also confirm in writing the claim number assigned to this loss.

We further request that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data and event recorder information, repair estimates, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any third-party reports. Please treat this letter as formal notice to retain these materials until the matter is fully resolved.
